UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Signed-in SplitFlow user profile, payment VPA, currency preference, and theme state.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

displayName.description: Display name shown across groups and splits.

upiVpa.description: Optional UPI Virtual Payment Address for settlement deep links.

darkMode.description: Whether dark editorial mode is enabled.

seededDemo.description: Whether initial demo ledger data has been seeded.

LedgerMember.title: LedgerMember
LedgerMember.description: A person in the user's ledger (self, verified friend, or claimable shadow Guest profile).

email.description: Optional email when claimed or verified.

upiVpa.description: Optional UPI VPA for instant settlement.

avatarColorHex.description: Hex color token for avatar badge.

selfProfile.description: True for the signed-in user's own member entry.

guestProfile.description: True for unverified shadow guest profiles.

claimedAtLabel.description: Optional date label when a guest profile was claimed.

dietPreference.description: Optional dietary preference for Veg/Non-Veg dining splits.

drinksAlcohol.description: Optional preference indicating whether the member participates in alcohol/bar splits.

ExpenseGroup.title: ExpenseGroup
ExpenseGroup.description: A collaborative expense group (Trip, Home, Event, Couple, Personal) with bounded members.

memberIds.description: Bounded list of LedgerMember IDs participating in this group.

accentColorHex.description: Hex color accent for group card.

budgetMinorUnits.description: Optional group spend budget cap in minor units.

splitMemoryNotes.description: Optional group split memory rules (e.g. dietary or custom room ratio defaults).

ExpenseRecord.title: ExpenseRecord
ExpenseRecord.description: An expense stored strictly in integer minor units with multi-payer support, split allocations, and optional itemized receipt lines.

groupId.description: Optional ExpenseGroup ID (omitted for 1-on-1 personal splits).

totalMinorUnits.description: Total expense in integer minor units (paise/cents).

shareCode.description: Shareable split code for public preview link.

aiExtracted.description: True when parsed via AI Expense Lens or Voice Splitter.

allocations.description: List of allocation maps {memberId, amountMinorUnits, percentageBps, shares}.

lineItems.description: List of itemized line maps {itemId, name, quantity, unitPriceMinor, totalPriceMinor, assignedMemberIds}.

serviceChargeMinorUnits.description: Receipt service charge or tip in minor units.

nextDueDateLabel.description: Optional ISO date label YYYY-MM-DD for next recurring due date.

receiptPhotoPath.description: Optional app-private local path to attached receipt photo.

fxRateToBaseMicros.description: Optional deterministic FX rate scaled by 1,000,000 for multi-currency conversion.

SettlementRecord.title: SettlementRecord
SettlementRecord.description: A recorded debt settlement transfer between two members in integer minor units.

groupId.description: Optional group ID associated with the settlement.

amountMinorUnits.description: Settlement amount in integer minor units.

note.description: Optional settlement note or UPI ref.

paymentProofPath.description: Optional app-private local path to attached UPI/bank settlement proof screenshot.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner profile settings, UPI VPA, and currency preferences.

/users/{userId}/members/{memberId}.description: User's contacts, self profile, and shadow Guest profiles.

/users/{userId}/expenses/{expenseId}.description: User's group and 1-on-1 personal expenses with itemized splits.

/users/{userId}/settlements/{settlementI.description: Recorded debt settlements and UPI transfers.
